SELECT
  t.name AS merchant_name,
  t.industry,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ws.started_at >= DATE '2023-10-01' AND ws.started_at < DATE '2024-01-01') AS sessions_q4_2023,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ws.started_at >= DATE '2024-10-01' AND ws.started_at < DATE '2025-01-01') AS sessions_q4_2024,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ws.started_at >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND ws.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01') AS sessions_q4_2025,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ws.started_at >= DATE '2024-10-01' AND ws.started_at < DATE '2025-01-01') = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ws.started_at >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND ws.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ws.started_at >= DATE '2024-10-01' AND ws.started_at < DATE '2025-01-01')) / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ws.started_at >= DATE '2024-10-01' AND ws.started_at < DATE '2025-01-01'), 1)
  END AS yoy_growth_pct_2024_to_2025,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ws.started_at >= DATE '2023-10-01' AND ws.started_at < DATE '2024-01-01') = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ws.started_at >= DATE '2024-10-01' AND ws.started_at < DATE '2025-01-01') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ws.started_at >= DATE '2023-10-01' AND ws.started_at < DATE '2024-01-01')) / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ws.started_at >= DATE '2023-10-01' AND ws.started_at < DATE '2024-01-01'), 1)
  END AS yoy_growth_pct_2023_to_2024
FROM tenants t
LEFT JOIN web_sessions ws ON ws.tenant_id = t.id
WHERE t.name IN (
  'Castell Fasteners', 'OfficeHub Nordic', 'Deskline Supplies',
  'Ballycorran Industrial Supply', 'Midland Safety Wear', 'Polder Packaging',
  'Kontor24 Burobedarf'
)
GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.industry
ORDER BY sessions_q4_2025 DESC, t.id ASC
LIMIT 50
note: YoY growth columns are blank (NULL) when the prior-year Q4 count is zero, per the request's definition; counts are raw web_sessions rows (all traffic, not deduplicated visitors).
